questions.question: It is possible to derive the value of GDP of a country. Which function of money is applicable here?

Which of the following statements is true?
A) Money Supply is a stock concept
B) Currency and Coins with the public are not included in M3 measure of money supply

Which of the following statements is correct about the value of money?
i. It is directly related to the price level.
ii. It is not related to the price level.
iii. It is indirectly related to the price level.
questions.option_2: None of the statements are correct

questions.question: The stabilisation function of the government budget mainly includes ________.
questions.option_1: intervention to expand or reduce the demand
questions.option_4: distribution of income in society in a fair way

questions.question: When the rate of interest is at its maximum, which of the following will follow?
questions.option_1: The speculative demand for money will be equal to the supply of money.
questions.option_2: The demand for bonds will be at its minimum.
questions.option_3: The speculative demand for money will be zero.
questions.option_4: The speculative demand for money will be at its maximum.

questions.question:
Identify the correct statement/s with respect to NABARD's EShakti project.
i. The project aimed to digitise the financial and non-financial data of all the SHGs.
ii. The project aimed to bring awareness about Digital India among the farmers.
iii. This project was launched by NABARD in March 2015.
In the estimation of national income, which of the following items will be subtracted from NNP at market price?
questions.option_1: Net product taxes and net production taxes

questions.question: Proportional taxes would help to reduce the autonomous expenditure multiplier because ________.
questions.option_2: MPC does not have any role in it

questions.question: Which of these statements is correct?
questions.option_1: The economic wealth of a country does not necessarily depend on the possession of resources.
questions.option_2: Countries endowed with natural resources are naturally the richest countries.
questions.option_3: The national income of a country is the total of all its resources.
questions.option_4: Whether resources are used in generating a flow of output and as a result, income and wealth, is immaterial.

questions.question: Which of these is one of the fallouts of the industrial licensing system?
questions.option_1: Large industrial houses availed licenses to prevent competition
questions.option_2: Most licenses were used up by backward states
questions.option_3: Most licenses were for importing goods
questions.option_4: Many small private firms appropriated licenses

questions.question: Which of these is NOT a characteristic of durable goods?
questions.option_1: They have a relatively long life.
questions.option_2: They are not extinguished by immediate consumption.
questions.option_3: They are capable of repetitive use.
questions.option_4: They are meant for repetitive purchases.

questions.question: Which of the following items is NOT a part of the non-plan revenue expenditure of the government budget?
questions.option_4: Central assistance for states and union territories

questions.question:

B) greater tax collections for the government
C) employment generation in the rural areas
Structural composition of the economy refers to:
questions.option_3: rural and urban distribution of the population
questions.option_4: contribution of various sectors to the GDP

questions.question: Exports of mangoes by India are a part of __________ method of measurement of its national income.
